REGION_TOMES.//: V11 (carried, Cam's yes, 2026-10-18; from PT16 t2): tomes earned by opening the world, each teaching ANY battle pet its moves (the move keeps its own type in the matchups), the strong ones behind battle levels 15/25/35/45, PP from each move's power by the V5 rule. `ground`: the first win there gives the tome (`ship`: a ship of that tier instead; `rematch`: a won rematch with the Archmage); its boss leaves one now and then after that (MOVE_TOMES.bossChance). A pet can learn MOVE_TOMES.max tome moves (3 since V11).

tomedavyjones.name: Davy Jones' Tome
tomedavyjones.lore: Salt-stained, and it smells of the deep. Someone drowned writing it.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.about: Drags at it: slowed for 2 rounds.

krakengrip.name: Kraken's grip
krakengrip.about: Holds it fast: stunned for a round. Twice a fight.

maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
maelstrom.about: The sea itself, more than twice as hard. Twice a fight.

tomecleopatra.name: Cleopatra's Tome
tomecleopatra.lore: Gold leaf on papyrus; the asp on the cover seems to move.

aspskiss.name: Asp's kiss
aspskiss.about: A poisoned bite: poisoned for 3 rounds.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.about: Sand in its eyes: off balance for 3 rounds.

pharaohscurse.name: Pharaoh's curse
pharaohscurse.about: Hard, and its guard breaks for 3 rounds. Twice a fight.

tomeredriver.name: Red River Tome
tomeredriver.lore: Written on reeds, tied with river grass. The ink is the colour of the flood.

crocroll.name: Crocodile roll
crocroll.about: Grabs and rolls: 50% more, a little less sure.

reedcover.name: Reed cover
reedcover.about: Hides in the reeds: half its blows miss for 2 rounds.

lotusrest.name: Lotus rest
lotusrest.about: Heals a third of its health.

tomeundead.name: Undead Tome
tomeundead.lore: Bound in something that isn't leather. The pages are cold.

cryptchill.name: Crypt chill
cryptchill.about: A grave's cold: slowed for 2 rounds.

bonerattle.name: Bone rattle
bonerattle.about: A dreadful sound: stunned for a round. Twice a fight.

lifeleech.name: Life leech
lifeleech.about: Heals for half the damage it deals.

tomefrostbite.name: Frostbite Tome
tomefrostbite.lore: Frost grows on it overnight, whatever the weather.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.about: Nearly twice as hard, and slowed for 2 rounds. Twice a fight.

tomecanopy.name: Canopy Tome
tomecanopy.lore: Pressed leaves between the pages, and a beetle that lives in the spine.

vinelash.name: Vine lash
vinelash.about: A thorned vine: it bleeds for 3 rounds.

ambushabove.name: Ambush from above
ambushabove.about: Drops out of the trees: 70% more, a little less sure.

monsoon.name: Monsoon
monsoon.about: 60% more, and off balance for 2 rounds. Twice a fight.

tomestar.name: Star Tome
tomestar.lore: Its pages are blank by day. At night, they're a map of the sky.

comet.name: Comet
comet.about: Out of the sky: 80% more, a little less sure.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.about: Heals nearly a third of its health.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.about: Its blows weaken for 3 rounds, and this one lands hard.
